in_marathi.name: Gurinder
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Guide of the soul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gurinder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gurinder is a Sanskrit name composed of two parts: ‘Gur’ meaning 'guide' or 'teacher', and ‘Indra’ meaning 'king' or 'ruler'. This name symbolizes a wise and enlightened leader who guides souls to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
